title: Analytic: 3D Hertzian dipole radiated power and far-field pattern
description:
A z-oriented electric point dipole (current moment Il = 1e-12 A m, gaussian pulse at 1 um) at the centre of a 1.2 um vacuum cube with CPML on all six faces (FDTD, em_fdtd_3d); the study sweeps the cell size dx_cell over 50, 40, 30, 25 nm (about 30 s in total).
Analytic: radiated cw power P = eta0 k^2 (Il)^2 / (12 pi) (0.4 nW at 1 um, ~1/lambda^2); far-field pattern sin^2(theta) from the dipole axis, i.e. cos^2(angle) in the x-z cut (angle from +x toward +z: maxima at 0 / 180 deg, nulls along +-z) and constant in the x-y cut.
Spectra tab: em.radiated_power (power, a.u. = 2 |S(f)|^2 x the cw power, S = the gaussian pulse spectrum) vs the dashed analytic spectrum.
Far field tab: em.far_xz vs the dashed cos^2(angle), em.far_xy vs the dashed constant (both peak-normalised; pick 0.9 / 1.0 / 1.1 um).
Derived values tab: P_rad (at 1 um), P_rad_short (0.9 um), P_rad_long (1.1 um) from power_per_cw with their analytic references (last sweep value, 25 nm).
Sweep tab: P_rad, P_rad_short, P_rad_long vs dx_cell with the dashed analytic values: lattice dispersion and the box quadrature give ~0.5 % at 50 nm, falling to ~0.15 % at 25 nm (the far-field patterns: ~2-3 % of the peak at 50 nm, below 1 % at 25 nm).

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: cube side (CPML outside, pml_cells 10 per face)

parameters.name: tau_pulse
parameters.description: gaussian envelope width [s]: g(t) = sin(2 pi f0 (t - t0)) exp(-((t - t0)/tau)^2)

parameters.name: box_lo
parameters.description: flux / far-field box lower faces (x, y, z)

parameters.name: box_hi
parameters.description: flux / far-field box upper faces (x, y, z)

parameters.name: P_dipole
parameters.description: analytic cw radiated power at lambda0 [W]: eta0 k^2 (Il)^2 / (12 pi)

parameters.name: P_short
parameters.description: analytic cw radiated power at lambda_short [W]

parameters.name: P_long
parameters.description: analytic cw radiated power at lambda_long [W]

parameters.name: band_stop
parameters.description: longest flux-box wavelength (26 points, 20 nm apart)

parameters.name: T_run
